display.purpose: The page title in each page's command bar.

headline.purpose: Default h1 outside the command bar.

title.purpose: h2 section heads and dialog titles.

pane-title.purpose: Head of each chart pane or tile.

body.purpose: Running text; empty-state copy caps at 52ch.

body-sm.purpose: Table cells, controls, buttons, nav links, legends.

label.purpose: Column heads, status chips, rail section labels, hints, crumbs. Sentence case.

mono.purpose: Hostnames, serials, versions, tokens, script bodies; never wraps.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting panes, KPI tiles, table panes, empty states, the active nav pill.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, search results, the login panel, linked KPI tile hover.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused controls and buttons; other focusables get a 2px primary outline at 2px offset.

shadows.name: pane-border
shadows.purpose: Light panes are edged by shadow alone; dark panes draw a 1px edge because soft shadows do not read on the dark ground.

shadows.name: login-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(60rem 36rem at 50% -10%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 12%, transparent), transparent 70%)
shadows.purpose: Faint wash of the mark's indigo behind the login panel. First screen only.

motion.name: transition
motion.purpose: Every state change: background, border, shadow, colour, rail collapse. Zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: Dialogs rise 8px on open; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: barlist-grow
motion.value: scaleX(0) to 1 over the transition token
motion.purpose: Chart bars grow in on first paint.

themes.mechanism: prefers-color-scheme: dark overrides the same custom properties in web/src/styles/tokens.css; frontmatter keys ending in -dark record the dark values.

components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview:
Retune is the same working console an endpoint engineer lives in all day, re-materialised from hard Fluent chrome into a soft, calm studio. Tonal layers and gentle depth do the work that hairlines and a saturated top band used to do: a lilac-tinted near-white page, white panes floating on soft two-layer shadows, and a sunken tone for wells, tracks and table heads. It should feel like a place, not a form. The fleet's state reads at a glance, actions are obvious, and nothing shouts except status.

Density is not negotiable. Tables keep 44px rows, identifiers never wrap, the nav rail keeps every destination visible, and KPI tiles and chart panes pack on a 16px gutter. Softness comes from material (tone, shadow, 12px pane and 8px control corners, pill chips), never from padding bloat or a consumer-app bounce. The system rejects the Intune admin-center clone look: no indigo top band, no 2px corners, no grey ramps, no borders drawn around everything.

Dark mode is designed, not inverted: an indigo-tinted charcoal where the page is the deepest layer, panes a step up and wells a step further, lifted by tone. Where soft shadows cannot read on the dark ground, a single 1px pane edge takes over.

**Provenance.** This world is an evolution of the incumbent console, pinned by the user's own words ("i like how everything looks now but I want it to look more inviting and softer"). FORM was fixed by that request; no concept roll ran, by design. Future work extends this world; it does not re-roll it.
keyCharacteristics: Lilac-tinted page ground with white panes that float on soft, indigo-tinted two-layer shadows.
Light header with a single saturated object, the indigo mark tile; no colour band.
Borderless tinted nav rail; the current page is a raised white pill.
Indigo is scarce: mark, active nav pill, focus, primary actions, text links, single-series data.
Status is always a word plus a dot on its own wash, never colour alone.
Figtree for every UI word, JetBrains Mono for every identifier.
Admin-center density held intact: 44px rows, nowrap identifiers, 16px gutters.

rules.name: The Rationed Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo appears only on the mark, the active nav pill, focus, primary actions, text links (which need an affordance) and single-series data such as the Enrollments bar chart. Anything else that wants indigo is either one of those or does not get it.

rules.name: The Status Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: The four status hues carry state and nothing else. Never use them for decoration, category colour or emphasis.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries a little of the mark's indigo. No pure greys, light or dark.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text token clears 4.5:1 against the page and pane grounds it sits on: ink-faint is #6b6782 in light (4.98:1 on paper) and #8d89a3 in dark (4.98:1 on the dark pane); status-neutral is #5d6275 in light. A lighter "faint" is a defect, not a style.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every table cell, count and figure uses tabular numerals, so numbers are read against each other in a column.

rules.name: The Identifier Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine issued (hostname, serial, version, token, hash) is set in JetBrains Mono and never wraps.

rules.name: The Edge Is The Shadow Rule
rules.body: In light, a pane is separated from the page by tone and shadow, never by a border. Hairlines are reserved for table row dividers and control borders.

rules.name: The Dark Edge Exception
rules.body: In dark, and only in dark, panes draw a 1px pane-border edge, because soft shadows vanish on the charcoal ground. It is a single quiet line, never a light glowing border.

rules.name: The One Ambient Glow
rules.body: The login screen carries a faint radial wash of the mark's own indigo (12%, `radial-gradient(60rem 36rem at 50% -10%, ...)`) behind the panel. First screen only; no other surface gets a gradient ground.

dos: **Do** set every page on the lilac paper and put content in white panes at 12px corners with the Card shadow and 20px padding.
**Do** keep tables at 44px rows inside their own pane, with tabular figures, nowrap identifiers in JetBrains Mono, and sideways scrolling on narrow screens.
**Do** show status as the word plus a dot on its wash, in one of the four status tones.
**Do** reserve indigo for the mark, the active nav pill, focus, primary actions, text links and single-series data.
**Do** let dark mode separate layers by tone, and draw the 1px pane-border edge on dark panes only.
**Do** use the shared 180ms curve for every state change and honour reduced motion.
**Do** hold every text token at 4.5:1 or better on its ground.
donts: **Don't** bring back the indigo top band, 2px corners, grey ramps, or borders around every pane: the Intune admin-center clone look.
**Don't** draw pane borders in light mode; the shadow is the edge.
**Don't** use a status colour for decoration or show state by colour alone.
**Don't** trade density for softness: no taller rows, no looser tables, no fewer nav items.
**Don't** go bubbly or consumer-app: no radii beyond 16px on containers, no bouncy motion, no playful illustration.
**Don't** put gradient or glow grounds on any screen but login.
**Don't** set UI text in the monospace or identifiers in Figtree.
**Don't** set labels, column heads or section names in uppercase or as eyebrow kickers over titles.
